error.message: Column SCDS11: two liquids on the stages (phases "VLL") need an activity model (NRTL, UNIQUAC, Modified UNIFAC 2.0) without the dimerizing acids' chemical theory, as the flash drum does; this system's vapour follows the chemical theory (dimerization) for Acetic acid (the three-phase flash with it is not built). Choose such a method for the column (its own property method), or phases "VL".
